reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

The highly unusual and very disruptive grounding of airline travel is extremely alarming. It impacts our economy and travelers across America, and especially here in my district where San Francisco International Airport is located. It’s incredibly frustrating the FAA hasn’t been more transparent about what is happening, and we need an immediate investigation into the cause and to understand what steps are being taken to prevent this from happening again.

Air traffic control is an essential federal service that protects public safety. While we don’t yet what has occurred exactly, I am very concerned about the possible impact from the Trump Administration’s ongoing cuts to government services – including slashing the FAA’s budget and air traffic control staffing.

Today’s ground stop is incredibly impactful for anyone traveling, and we urgently need more clarity from the FAA about what is being done to ensure flights can resume quickly and safely.

Recently, my district office received a suspicious envelope containing white powder, similar to what was sent to other Congressional offices across the country.

When the envelope arrived at our office, my staff immediately reached out to local law enforcement, which quickly responded. I am grateful to Capitol Police and our local first responders for their continued dedication to protecting our communities against these threats.

Political violence and intimidation have no place in our country, regardless of party, and especially during an election year. These attempts to threaten public servants and our staff will not deter us from our work. Thankfully, our team is trained to follow the proper safety protocols when handling suspicious mail and everyone is safe. We remain committed to serving California's 15th District with pride and dedication.
